Udacity Data Analyst WeRateDogs data-wrangling project.

From messy social data to a usable dataset

Gather, assess and clean social-post records and image predictions before exploring the combined data.

Python · pandas · Data wrangling · Matplotlib · Seaborn

The question

Inconsistent fields and multiple source tables make even simple analysis unreliable.

The work

  • Gather archive records and image-prediction data.
  • Identify quality and tidiness issues and create a cleaned master table.
  • Explore breed distributions, prediction confidence and engagement patterns.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Original figures summarize top predicted breeds and the relationship between likes and retweets.

What I learned

  • Document cleaning decisions and distinguish prediction confidence from measured accuracy.

Project context

  • Aggregated figures only; individual social-post records are not republished.
  • An original plot titled “accuracy” actually summarizes dog-classification flags and is not included.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
